messages.subject: fileInput() without copying it locally
parts: I have a shiny app that takes a text file with fileInput() and displays it in a data table, simple. The problem is that for large files fileInput() takes a long time to copy and put into a temporary folder for the session. In my app, the large file is on a NAS, (The server that shiny is on is has access to this NAS). Is there any way for shiny to not copy the file and just get the path to the file? Currently the only way I can get it to work is to have a textInput that is a string of the path. But I would like the browse folder feature as it is a lot more user friendly. Any suggestions?
